purpose: Machine-checked source route and shared-surface inventory for the redesign.
statusMeaning: baseline means the current implementation is the recorded starting point; partial means a relevant execution-log slice shipped but the surface work remains incomplete; pending means the redesign spec identifies work with no completion recorded.
